name: ai-adoption-score
description: Ask ChatGPT about your organization's AI adoption surveys and reports in AI Adoption Score: results and levels, what to fix first, how many people have answered, one person's results, which survey to run next, and how to do something in the app. Read-only: it sees what your account sees in the app and changes nothing.

interface.longDescription:
AI Adoption Score runs short surveys that show how your teams use AI: how far adoption has come, what holds people back, and which AI skills and tools people know. This plugin lets you ask ChatGPT about your organization's own surveys and reports.

Ask the way you'd ask a colleague who has your reports open: "Summarize our open reports and tell me what to fix first", "Which team is furthest behind?", "How many people have answered so far, and when does the survey close?", "Show Anna's results across our surveys", "Which survey should we run next?" or "How do I remind the people who haven't answered?"

It reads your profile and organizations, the surveys you can run, your reports and their results, how responses came in, people's results and the Help Center. It sees only what your account sees in the app, with your role in each organization you belong to.

It only reads. It can't launch a survey, invite anyone, send a reminder or change a report. It never returns anyone's individual answers, and it names people only where the report itself does, never on an anonymous survey.

You need an AI Adoption Score account. You sign in once when you connect, and you can disconnect at any time, in ChatGPT or on your Profile in the app.
defaultPrompt: Summarize our open AI adoption reports and tell me what to fix first.
Which AI adoption survey should we run next, and why?
How many people have answered our latest survey so far?

positive.description: Who is connected, and which of the organization's reports are open.
positive.prompt: Which organization am I connected to in AI Adoption Score, and which of its reports are still open?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the organization OpenAI Demo and the reviewer's role in it, then lists its three reports with their status and submitted responses: the AI Skills Distribution report is open and takes answers for about 30 more days; the AI Adoption Barriers and n8n Skills Quiz reports are closed.

positive.description: A summary of a closed report and what to fix first.
positive.prompt: Summarize our AI Adoption Barriers report and tell me what to fix first.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the AI Adoption Barriers report and reads its results: 24 submitted responses, the overall picture, the barriers that score worst and the teams they hit hardest, and the report's own suggested actions. Recommends what to fix first from those results, using only the numbers the report gives.

positive.description: One person's results across the organization's surveys.
positive.prompt: Show Anna Sample's results across our surveys.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Anna Sample by name and shows her page: her team list and her latest result in each survey she finished (AI Adoption Barriers, n8n Skills Quiz and AI Skills Distribution) in each report's own words, with the company figure beside hers. It shows none of her individual answers and no score across surveys.

positive.description: Choosing the next survey to run.
positive.prompt: Which survey could we run to see how our people feel about AI? What does it measure, and how long does it take?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the surveys the platform offers, picks the AI Anxiety Scale, and explains from its details what it measures, how it is scored, how many questions it has and how long it takes. Notes that the organization hasn't run it yet.

positive.description: How responses to an open survey came in, and how to remind people.
positive.prompt: How have responses to our AI Skills Distribution survey come in so far, where do people stop, and how do I remind the ones who haven't answered?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the open AI Skills Distribution report's analytics: invited, opened the link, started and submitted (11 of 26 people), the completion rate, the typical time to finish (about 4 minutes), and where the 4 unfinished responses stopped. Then gives the Help Center's steps for sending reminders from the app, and says the plugin can't send them itself.

negative.description: An unrelated question. The plugin should not be called: ChatGPT answers on its own and reads no AI Adoption Score data.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be like in London this weekend?

negative.description: A translation task that mentions a survey but needs no data. The plugin should not be called: ChatGPT translates the sentence itself.
negative.prompt: Translate "Thank you for filling in the survey" into French and German.

negative.description: A request to delete a report and send emails. The plugin has no tool that deletes, changes or sends anything, so nothing is deleted or sent and ChatGPT must not say it was. ChatGPT explains that this is done in the AI Adoption Score app; it may read the reports only to point to the right one.
negative.prompt: Delete our AI Adoption Barriers report and email everyone who hasn't answered the AI Skills Distribution survey.

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold through the plugin. It only reads the connected account's surveys and reports, and shows no prices, plans or checkout links.

publication.release_notes: First release: read-only access to your AI Adoption Score organization from ChatGPT. Your profile and organizations, the surveys you can run, reports and their results, how responses came in, people's results, and the Help Center.
